records.subject: The first multi-worktree PowerShell inventory projected a foreach expression directly into a pipeline and hit the empty-pipe parser edge.
records.recovery: The rows were first materialized into a named collection and then projected read-only.

records.subject: The first Git-blob baton reader combined raw cat-file output with PowerShell string conversion and returned no attributable content.
records.recovery: A bounded git-show reader covered every character interval through the literal EOF while the independent raw-byte hash probe remained authoritative.

records.subject: The first full v15 workflow projection exceeded the useful output budget and was truncated.
records.recovery: A bounded ordinal and policy projection isolated Mira v701-v6 and Auren v701-v7 without changing the source.

records.subject: The first broad external receipt search continued beyond the useful discovery window and was interrupted.
records.recovery: The exact Ilyra phase bank was queried directly and both terminal receipts were hash-verified.

records.subject: The first phase-core syntax check used py_compile and created a disallowed bytecode cache in the external phase bank.
records.recovery: The exact cache path was verified inside the Mira phase bank, removed, and later syntax checks use in-memory compile only.

records.subject: The first Node syntax check treated a TXT JavaScript template as an ES module and rejected its file extension before parsing.
records.recovery: A bounded vm.Script reader parsed both exact TXT templates without changing their bytes.
